purpose: Teach: アンプ/エンタープライズ/タイムズ/バーツ/カンパニー/キーパー/エコノミスト/ウィルコム

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、アンプを自社製造された
lines.en: Your father — when he was starting out, he manufactured the amplifiers in-house himself.
lines.style: Gentle, measured recollection. Soft opening. The tone of someone sharing a piece of history they're still proud of, without needing to convince.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはエンタープライズ向け事業に早く進出された
lines.en: Yes. He moved into enterprise business earlier than most.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Steady, respectful. Recognition of the accomplishment without excess. The tone of someone continuing a thread he understands deeply.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、海外のタイムズ紙の取材を受けられた
lines.en: Your father — in his younger days, he was interviewed by the Times overseas.
lines.style: Wistful, almost wondering. Soft pace. The voice of someone remembering an achievement from a distance, with quiet admiration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはタイ進出時のバーツ取引を成功された
lines.en: Yes. When he went into Thailand, he handled the baht trading successfully.
lines.style: Reflective, looking inward. Measured pace. Speaking of it as something understood in hindsight — a decision that proved sound.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、海外子会社のカンパニーを次々設立された
lines.en: Your father — he established subsidiary companies overseas, one after another.
lines.style: Wistful wonder in the delivery. Slight breathiness. The amazement of someone reflecting on ambition and reach, spread across time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員をデータのキーパーとして信頼された
lines.en: Yes. He trusted his employees as keepers of the data — the foundation of everything.
lines.style: Reflective, almost meditative. Slight emphasis on trust. The voice recognising a deeper principle beneath the business decision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、エコノミスト誌の常読者だった
lines.en: Your father — in his youth, he was a regular reader of The Economist.
lines.style: Wistful, almost tender. Unhurried. The affection in recalling a small habit that said everything about a person's mind.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはウィルコムの全盛期も経験された
lines.en: Yes. He experienced WILLCOM's peak years as well.
lines.style: Wise, gentle close. Quiet completion. The voice of someone marking the end of an era he witnessed, with calm acceptance.
